product: TRISENS / BLISKA dining chair, model TR-92
summary: Fit the two leg pieces together in a cross, then screw the leg cross under the upholstered seat shell.

The seat shell is modelled as one curved upholstered shell. The quilting is not shown.

A.name: Seat shell (seat and backrest)
A.look: Upholstered quilted seat with a high backrest. It has 4 screw holes in its underside.

B.name: Leg piece B
B.look: Two splayed legs joined by a top bar. The bar has a notch in the middle that faces down.

C.name: Leg piece C
C.look: Two splayed legs joined by a top bar. The bar has a notch in the middle that faces up, matching B.

D.name: Short Allen bolt
D.look: The short bolt. There is only one.

E.name: Long Allen bolt
E.look: The longer bolts. There are four.

steps.title: Join the legs in a cross
steps.text: Push leg pieces B and C into each other crosswise so the notches in the middle lock together. Fix them in the centre with the short bolt D and one washer F, using the Allen key G.
steps.tip: Use the short bolt D here. Keep the four long bolts E for the seat.

steps.title: Screw the leg cross under the seat
steps.text: Lay the seat shell A upside down on a soft surface. Place the leg cross on it so the 4 holes in the leg bars line up with the 4 holes in the seat. Fix it with the 4 long bolts E and 4 washers F, using the Allen key.
steps.tip: Start all 4 bolts by hand before tightening any of them, so the holes stay lined up.

steps.title: Tighten and stand the chair up
steps.text: Check all joints and tighten every bolt firmly. Turn the chair over and stand it on its legs. Tighten all bolts again after about 5 weeks.
steps.tip: Loose bolts make the chair wobble. Check them regularly.
steps.warn: Maximum user weight is 110 kg. Do not stand on the chair.
